text:
alyssa: Kickoff for ZephyrCorp dedicated bring-up. We're scheduling a stepped loadtest to validate slotting + autoscale. Plan: progressive 10min steps at 5%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 100% of booked RPS. Need quota window, throttle settings, and KMS handoff. Target go window: Mon 2026-04-06 14:00 PT. Thoughts?

jordan: +1. Can we reserve an extra 15% headroom for burst during priming? Also will need a warmup cache policy so prefix hits don't skew metrics.

samir: @jordan yes on headroom. For autoscale let's keep initial downscale delay at 600s, upscale at 30s. We'll watch p95 latency. I'll provide a draft HPA-like policy.

marta: from CS: Zephyr's renewal is end of May — we need clean results by 4/10. Also they want a dryrun with their internal traffic generator. Can ops run an external-targeted test?

samir: ops-bot: scheduling note: we can run from the shadow pool at 14:00 PT if capacity team confirms slot mapping. Command we'll use for their generator:

```
./loadgen --target https://redwood-dedicated.example/ingest \
  --rps 1200 --steps 300,600,1200,1800,2400 --step-duration 600 \
  --concurrency 50 --headers "x-cust:zephyr"
```

alyssa: tagging @ops-bot for slot mapping and @kevin-cs for stakeholder comms. Provide a one-pager outcome template (success/fallback) pls.

ops-bot: slot-mapper: allocated slots 42-48 on pool-eu-west. Throttle template set to `quota:95%`, `burst:20%`, `qs-window:60s`. Will confirm KMS access by EOD.

kevin-cs: I'll prepare the stakeholder readout and QA checklist. Quick Q: what's our rollback trigger? p99>1.5s or error rate>0.5%?

samir: rollback triggers agreed: p99>1.5s sustained for 2 steps OR 0.5%+ error at 1 step. Also keep fallback to model-lite variant if GPU saturation hits 85%.

marta: capturing feedback: ask Zephyr to provide 3 critical prompts that must not regress — we will run evals post-load. I'll coordinate with them.

alyssa: perfect. Action items: samir (autoscale policy + rollback), ops-bot (confirm KMS+slot map), kevin-cs (stakeholder readout), marta (eval prompts). Meeting at 13:30 PT day-of for final go/no-go. :thumbsup:
